items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: Shared utility functions including the cn() helper for Tailwind class merging.

items.name: animated-image
items.title: Animated Image
items.description: A diamond-shaped image that morphs into a full rectangle on hover with grayscale-to-color transition.

items.name: shiny-wrap
items.title: Shiny Wrapper
items.description: A wrapper component that adds a shiny sweeping animation over its children. Supports gradient and solid styles, looping, and hover-only mode.

items.name: tilt-image
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A 3D tilt card component that responds to mouse movement with configurable rotation, perspective, and scale.

items.name: hover-flip-card
items.title: Hover Flip Card
items.description: A card that flips 180 degrees on hover to reveal a background image with parallax-like mouse tracking.

items.name: diamond-gallery
items.title: Diamond Gallery
items.description: A diamond-shaped gallery layout with 4 images arranged in a cross pattern. Hovering an image expands it while blurring the others.

items.name: hoverbox-effect
items.title: Hover Box Effect
items.description: A 3D box that flips on hover to reveal its back face. Supports configurable perspective, transition duration, and grayscale filter.

items.name: hover-gallery
items.title: Hover Gallery
items.description: A stacked image gallery that expands into a 2x2 grid on hover with smooth motion animations.

items.name: inline-table-control
items.title: Inline Table Control
items.description: An inline-editable table with animated row-to-form transitions, focus management, and spring-based motion layout.

items.name: scroll-feed-tabs
items.title: Scroll Feed Tabs
items.description: A neon-styled tab bar with pointer-reactive glow, animated clip-path transitions, and radial gradient effects. Inspired by Peerlist.

items.name: hover-disclosure
items.title: Hover Disclosure
items.description: An accordion-style disclosure panel where hovering an item expands it to reveal full content with image, icon, and description.

items.name: svg-filters
items.title: SVG Filters
items.description: GSAP-powered SVG filter effects including turbulence and displacement map distortion with hover-triggered animations and caption overlays.

items.name: splitflap
items.title: Splitflap Display
items.description: A splitflap departure-board style display powered by GSAP. Supports configurable text lines, colors, character sets, and play/blank controls.

items.name: valorant-button
items.title: Valorant Button
items.description: A stylized button inspired by Valorant with 4 variants: default (squiggle slice), liquid (morphing layers), neon (glowing flicker), and warp (light streaks).

items.name: spider-button
items.title: Spider-Man Button
items.description: A Spider-Man themed animated button with glitch hover effects, color variants, and comic-style click animations powered by motion.

items.name: album-card
items.title: Album Cards
items.description: Expandable album cards that animate open to reveal lyrics with highlighted line cycling. Supports mobile carousel navigation.

items.name: artist-list
items.title: Artist List
items.description: A speaker-style artist list with hover-to-reveal profile images, social links, and spring animations. Responsive with mobile layout support.

items.name: draggable-cards
items.title: Draggable Cards
items.description: Scattered draggable cards with physics-based drag, z-index stacking, and responsive sizing. Great for album art or portfolio showcases.
